title: Director Minerva Frontline (All genders)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Why Join Us?</span></strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&amp;D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About the Team</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Minerva is STARK’s overarching Mission Operating System — the central cognitive backbone connecting all our unmanned platforms across air, land, and sea, while seamlessly integrating third-party systems and interfacing directly with national Battle Management Systems (BMS). Within this ecosystem, the <strong>Minerva Frontline</strong> organization owns the entire human-machine interface and operator experience on the ground. Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — <strong>Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation</strong> — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest.</span></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Your Mission</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">As <strong>Director Minerva Frontline</strong>, you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command &amp; Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience. You will set the visionary product roadmap internally while representing our capabilities externally to military stakeholders, procurement agencies, and partners across NATO nations.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Own the end-to-end Minerva Frontline program</strong>, taking full accountability for its strategic roadmap, program budget, commercial targets, and cross-functional delivery across all three product lines.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Lead, mentor, and empower three direct reports</strong> and scale the broader multi-disciplinary organization across Berlin and Munich in these teams.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Define and communicate a compelling product vision</strong> internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline</strong>, pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Drive seamless system interoperability</strong>, ensuring Minerva Frontline connects effortlessly with STARK’s physical unmanned platforms, third-party assets, and sovereign Battle Management Systems .</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements</strong> into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO)</strong> over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads</strong> to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience</strong> managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites</strong>, ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector</strong>, with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Exceptional internal and external communication skills</strong> — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset</strong>, capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Willingness to travel regularly</strong> between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Fluency in English</strong> (written and spoken) is mandatory.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Nice-To-Have</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Prior military service</strong> (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Fluency in German</strong>, enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>An established network within the European defence ecosystem</strong>, military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description: <p><strong>REQ ID: FEQ227R147</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Germany (Remote/Hybrid) - will require travel across Europe</strong></p> <p><strong>Recruiter: Dina Hussain</strong></p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our <strong>EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups </strong>business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.</li> <li>Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.</li> <li>Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.</li> <li>Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.</li> <li>Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from&nbsp;<strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships.</p> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End Partner &amp; Campaign Management:</strong> Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"):</strong> Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks.</li> <li><strong>Key Account Growth ("Farming"):</strong> Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional &amp; Product Line Expansion:</strong> Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products.</li> <li><strong>Operational &amp; Tracking Excellence:</strong> Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds).</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Performance &amp; Cost Control:</strong> Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels.</li> <li><strong>Process Innovation &amp; Internal Advocacy:</strong> Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <h4><strong>Must-Haves</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region.</li> <li><strong>Deep Domain &amp; Technical Knowledge:</strong> Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends.</li> <li><strong>Commercial &amp; We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.</p> <p>Stripe's financial infrastructure is the engine that unlocks new revenue streams, automates complex local compliance, and drives global expansion for the region's most prominent businesses. This is a pivotal moment for Stripe in DACH — the market opportunity is significant, and our team serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on the product roadmap and growth strategy. differentiated value—both business and technical—for each customer.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning new business <li>Own the full sales cycle end to end—from executive engagement and lead generation through scoping, solution design, commercial negotiation, closing, onboarding, activation, and early expansion.</li> <li>Proactively generate your own pipeline through targeted outreach (e.g. cold calling, blitzing, research, networking, events, partners) and by driving a clear territory and account opportunities.</li> <li>Ensure every potential and existing Stripe user has an excellent, high-touch experience at every interaction, regardless of deal size, seniority, or stage of the roadmaps.</li> <li>Orchestrate and coordinate cross-functional Stripe teams (e.g. Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Operations, Marketing, Partnerships, Leadership) to align on strategy and ensure internal resources are set up for user success and long-term growth.</li> </ul> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>6+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a highly technical product to enterprise customers, with a track record of top performance&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products</li> <li>Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations</li> <li>A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally</li> <li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and in German</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong interest and knowledge in technology, the payments landscape, and related products, with the ability to advise customers strategically on payments, monetization, and platform architecture.</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills, including experience crafting and delivering thinking back into concrete operational execution across internal teams and customer stakeholders.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Aufgaben

  • Als SAP FI Berater (m/w/d) analysieren und optimieren Sie SAP-Finanzprozesse mit Schwerpunkt Bankbuchhaltung, Zahlungsverkehr, Cash Management und Treasury
  • Zudem konfigurieren Sie SAP S/4HANA und entwickeln Lösungen für die elektronische Kontoauszugsverarbeitung, automatisierte Buchungen und den Kontoausgleich

Qualifikationen

  • Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA Finance mit, insbesondere in Bankbuchhaltung, Cash Management und Treasury

  • Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in der elektronischen Kontoauszugsverarbeitung, im Zahlungsverkehr und im SAP-Customizing
  • Zusätzlich haben Sie Erfahrung mit SAP Cash Management, SAP Fiori und KI-gestützter Kontoauszugsverarbeitung, idealerweise auch mit SAP Analytics Cloud
  • Wichtig sind analytisches Denken, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke und die Bereitschaft zur Wissensvermittlung

Benefits

  • Sicherheit: Krisensicherer Arbeitgeber im Öffentlichen Dienst
  • Vielseitigkeit: Freuen Sie sich aufspannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld

title: Projektleiter HKLS / Versorgungstechnik (m/w/d)
description: Sie möchten technisch anspruchsvolle Großprojekte in der Gebäudeausrüstung leiten, abends aber verlässlich zu Hause bei Ihrer Familie sein? Hier übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für Vorhaben bis 10 Millionen Euro Volumen und profitieren dabei von echtem Zusammenhalt und einem Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung. Sie suchen nach einer Position mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, wünschen sich aber dennoch die finanzielle Sicherheit eines Großkonzerns mit vollen Auftragsbüchern bis 2029? Sie schätzen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Leistung anerkannt wird und Kollegen einander auf der Baustelle wirklich unterstützen. Dann erwartet Sie hier bei einem Gehalt von 65.000 bis 85.000 € je nach Erfahrung genau diese Kombination. Ihr neuer Arbeitgeber ist eine mittelständisch geprägte Geschäftseinheit innerhalb eines großen europäischen Konzerns. Das Unternehmen agiert als Gesamtdienstleister für die technische Gebäudeausrüstung und realisiert regionale Großprojekte in den Bereichen Industrie, Gesundheitswesen und öffentliche Hand. Die Niederlassung verbindet den pragmatischen Zusammenhalt eines Handwerksbetriebs mit der Struktur und Finanzkraft eines großen Netzwerks. Projektleiter HKLS / Versorgungstechnik (m/w/d) | 65.000-85.000 € brutto/Jahr + Firmenwagen Ihre Perspektiven Regionale Projekte & Freizeit: Sie steuern Projekte im Umkreis von 100 bis 150 Kilometern und übernachten im eigenen Bett. Eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance wird durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit und eine flexible Einteilung unterstützt. Stabilität & Freiraum: Die Auftragsbücher sind bis 2029 gefüllt. Gleichzeitig agieren Sie in Ihrem Projekt wie ein Unternehmer im Unternehmen und haben die Freiheit, Abläufe im Sinne des Projekterfolgs pragmatisch anzupassen. Fahrzeug & Ausstattung: Sie erhalten einen frei konfigurierbaren Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung der Marken VW, BMW, Ford oder Mercedes. Moderne Arbeitsmittel inklusive Laptop und Smartphone sind selbstverständlich. Echte Wertschätzung: Hier sind Sie keine Personalnummer. Flache Hierarchien, ein familiärer Teamzusammenhalt und Vorgesetzte, die bei Problemen den Rücken stärken und selbst mit auf die Baustelle kommen, prägen den Alltag. Zusatzleistungen & Gesundheit: Sie profitieren von Angeboten wie EGYM Wellpass, Jobrad, Corporate Benefits und einer betrieblichen Zusatzkrankenversicherung. Gemeinsame Sommerfeste, Kickerturniere und Ausflüge runden das Angebot ab. Ihre Aufgaben Sie übernehmen die eigenverantwortliche Projektleitung im Bereich Heizung, Klima, Lüftung und Sanitär für Vorhaben zwischen 500.000 und 10 Millionen Euro Volumen. Sie steuern den gesamten Projektablauf von der Werk- und Montageplanung ab der Leistungsphase 5 bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Kunden. Sie koordinieren und überwachen Nachunternehmer sowie Lieferanten, da das Unternehmen die Anlagenplanung und -steuerung ohne eigene Montagekapazitäten durchführt. Sie behalten Zeit, Budget und Qualität stets im Blick und stellen den Projekterfolg durch eine vorausschauende Kapazitäts- und Personaleinsatzplanung sicher. Sie prüfen Planungsunterlagen kritisch, bewerten die eingesetzte Technik vor allem auf der Luft- und Wasserseite und decken Planungsfehler frühzeitig auf. Sie arbeiten eng mit den Bauleitern vor Ort zusammen und greifen bei technischen oder terminlichen Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert ein. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossene handwerkliche Ausbildung im Bereich HKLS (z. B. Anlagenmechaniker SHK, Heizungsbauer) Oder alternativ Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker / Meister in der Versorgungstechnik Oder alternativ ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung, Versorgungstechnik oder Umwelttechnik Fundierte Berufserfahrung ab 7 Jahren in der eigenverantwortlichen Bau- und Projektleitung von HKLS-Anlagenbauprojekten mit Volumina im Millionenbereich innerhalb Deutschlands. Sicheres technisches Fachwissen in der Lüftungs- und Klimatechnik (inkl. Brandschutz) sowie auf der Wasserseite (Hydraulik, Pumpenauslegung). Sicherer Umgang mit der VOB (A, B, C) sowie den einschlägigen DIN-Normen. Routinierter Umgang mit MS Office; Kenntnisse in ERP-Systemen oder PlanRadar sind von Vorteil. Deutsch: C1 Führerschein der Klasse B. Lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Resilienz bei Projektdruck und die Fähigkeit, konstruktiv mit Nachunternehmern sowie Kunden zu kommunizieren. Interessiert? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt unkompliziert bei Ihrer Ansprechpartnerin Juliane Stork. Ihre Beratung durch Riverstate ist für Sie selbstverständlich kostenlos. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.</p> <p>Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.</p> <p>Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.</p> <h3><strong>The role, in a nutshell</strong></h3> <p>Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Staff Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, and you will lead the small sub-teams of two to four engineers that own them.</p> <p>Chainguard is growing explosively. description: <h3>United Kingdom (Remote)</h3> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees: while driving measurable ROI.</p> <p>We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether you’re engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event &amp; brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with your marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stack and is powered by a world-class team with hubs in New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for an exceptional Senior Financial Planning &amp; Analysis (FP&amp;A) Analyst to help us understand performance, plan for the future, and make better business decisions. Reporting to our CFO, you'll own core planning and forecasting, turn data into clear insights and recommendations, and work directly with leaders and teams across the business to improve decisions and execution.</p> <p>Our business model uniquely combines SaaS and prepaid customer wallets with a global gift marketplace, branded merchandise, and international fulfilment. That creates complex planning and analysis across recurring and transactional revenue, margins, cash and wallet dynamics, and multiple entities and currencies.</p> <p>Your impact will extend well beyond building models and reporting numbers. You'll bring ideas and perspective, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and help turn analysis into action. You'll be equally adept at getting into the details and stepping back to understand what the numbers mean for the business.</p> <p>You'll work across NetSuite, Salesforce, DealHub, and our reporting tools, with a strong focus on automation and AI, helping build an FP&amp;A function that is insightful, efficient, and closely connected to the business.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the consolidated operating model and rolling P&amp;L and cash forecasts across entities and revenue streams, including customer wallet balances.</li> <li>Own the annual budget and quarterly forecasting process, with clear analysis of performance, variances, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Work directly with leaders and budget holders across the business to understand performance, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and drive work through completion.</li> <li>Prepare monthly management reporting and board and investor materials, turning financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations.</li> <li>Analyse unit economics and margin by revenue stream to support pricing, deal, investment, and other commercial decisions.</li> <li>Define and maintain consistent definitions for key business metrics, including ARR, retention, and margin by revenue stream, ensuring they reconcile to reported financials each month.</li> <li>Calculate sales commissions and support the design and review of commission plans.</li> <li>Provide transaction analysis to support tax decisions, including VAT registrations and disclosures, and US sales tax thresholds.</li> <li>Maintain accurate dashboards and self-service performance reporting for budget holders and leadership, partnering with our business systems team on data and integrations.</li> <li>Improve and automate forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis, using AI and other tools to increase the speed and quality of our work.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Typically 2–5 years of relevant experience with increasing responsibility in FP&amp;A, corporate finance, audit, transaction services, or another highly analytical finance role.</li> <li>Excellent financial modelling skills, including driver-based forecasting and experience building or working with integrated financial models.</li> <li>Strong business judgement and curiosity, with the ability to move from analysis to clear implications, recommendations, and action.</li> <li>Proven ability to take ownership, work effectively across teams, build credibility with non-finance colleagues, and drive work through completion.</li> <li>Strong accounting foundation and the ability to connect operational metrics, forecasts, and financial results back to the general ledger.</li> <li>Skilled at working with data across multiple systems; ERP and CRM experience is valuable, with NetSuite and Salesforce preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated fluency with AI and automation tools, with a track record of applying them to improve the speed and quality of Finance work.</li> <li>Clear, concise communicator who can explain complex analysis to non-finance audiences and produce high-quality materials for senior leaders and the board.</li> <li>Proactive, highly organised, and effective in a fast-moving international business where priorities can evolve quickly.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with SaaS metrics such as ARR, retention, and cohort analysis.</li> <li>Experience with marketplace, physical goods, prepaid, or payments business models.</li> <li>Experience with multi-entity or multi-currency planning across the UK, US, or Europe.</li> <li>Experience with SQL, Power BI, Looker, or similar data and reporting tools.</li> <li>Exposure to sales commissions, indirect tax, or other transaction-level financial analysis.</li> <li>Part-qualified or fully qualified ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification is a plus.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>The Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous stock options</li> <li>Pension with employer contributions (NEST)</li> <li>Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care</li> <li>Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments</li> <li>A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Privacy Policy: We process personal information submitted as part of your application in accordance with the Reachdesk Candidate Privacy Notice. Please review Reachdesk’s Privacy Policy here:</em></p> <p><a href="http://www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy"><em>www.reachdesk.com/candidate-privacy-policy</em></a><em>&nbsp;</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Moniepoint, data is at the core of everything we do. We are a customer-centric company, and your work will enable our teams to make informed, data-driven decisions that directly impact the success of our business. We are seeking a data-driven, impact-oriented Senior Data Scientist to power Moniepoint’s consumer lending decisions at scale. You will build the models, experiments, and insights that shape how we acquire, underwrite, and retain millions of customers across Nigeria and Africa.</p> <p>This role is pivotal in driving our pricing, credit limit modelling, and credit model deployment strategy in a growing business with unparalleled opportunities to give access to millions of customers.&nbsp;You’ll collaborate with our amazing Consumer Credit team and drive how we think about risk ranking, product offering, and data infrastructure to create the best personalised offers for our customers. You’ll be responsible for building our first suite of credit risk models and help drive a culture of how we should think about machine learning vs more traditional methods - bringing fresh thinking to inspire both the team and our customers.</p> <p>Sitting at the intersection of data science, credit risk, and product, you’ll translate complex data into actionable decisions that drive growth with healthy portfolio performance.</p> <p><em>Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? <a href="https://moniepoint.com/blog">Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.</a></em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and deploy credit scoring, affordability, and behavioural models to support underwriting, pricing, and collections</li> <li>Design and run experiments to optimise approval rates, loss rates, and profitability</li> <li>Partner with product squads to embed decision logic into real-time systems</li> <li>Ensure data quality, compliance, and ethical use of models across all decisioning processes</li> <li>Mentor product squads on best practices in experimentation and data-driven decision-making</li> <li>Provide models to optimise outcomes in collections, churn management and user retention</li> </ul> <p><strong>We would love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable with Statistics and have a Degree or qualifications&nbsp; in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or similar)</li> <li>You have +5 years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within financial services</li> <li>Working knowledge of credit risk, consumer lending, and regulatory considerations</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and at least one modelling/programming language (Python, R)</li> <li>Experience with A/B testing, machine learning, collections modelling and churn management</li> <li>Ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for business stakeholders</li> <li>High ownership mindset and comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Culture: We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.</li> <li>Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.</li> <li>Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, monthly bonuses, plus other benefits</li> </ul> <p><strong>What to expect in the hiring process</strong></p> <ul> <li>A preliminary phone call with the recruiter</li> <li>A coding exercise on HackerRank - covering core data science theory (math, statistics, linear algebra) and Python fundamentals (data structures &amp; algorithms).</li> <li>A take-home assignment</li> <li>A technical interview with a Lead in our Data Science Team to review your take-home assignment in depth</li> <li>A behavioural and technical interview with the hiring manager</li> </ul> <p><em>Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.</em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
description: <p><strong>Who we are</strong></p> <p>Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.&nbsp;</p> <p>As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.</p> <p><strong>Why United Kingdom</strong></p> <p>The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based. Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.</p> <p>So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>About The Role</strong></p> <p>Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.</p> <p>Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.</p> <p>The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.</p> <p>This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.</p> <p>Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.</p> <p>You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:</p> <ul> <li>Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.</li> <li>Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.</li> <li>Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.</li> <li>Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.</li> <li>Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.</li> <li>Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.</li> <li>Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.</li> <li>Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.</li> <li>Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.</li> <li>Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.</li> <li>Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.</li> <li>Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.</li> <li>At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.</li> <li>Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.</li> <li>10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.</li> <li>Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.</li> <li>Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.</li> <li>Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.</li> <li>Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.</li> <li>Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cultural Alignment</strong></p> <p>As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.</p> <ul> <li>Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.</li> <li>Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.</li> <li>Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.</li> <li>Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.</li> <li>Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.</li> <li>No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.</li> <li>Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.</li> <li>Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like In The Role</strong></p> <ul> <li>The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.</li> <li>A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.</li> <li>A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.</li> <li>An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.</li> <li>Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.</li> <li>Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Join Us</strong></p> <ul> <li>A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.</li> <li>Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.</li> <li>Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.</li> <li>Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What To Expect In The Hiring Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.</li> <li>60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.</li> <li>60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.</li> <li>60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder &amp; Group CTO (the hiring manager).</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.</span></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Retention & Monetisation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.</p> <p>We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.</p> <p>You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.</p> <p>We joined Hims &amp; Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.</p> <p>We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.</p> <p>We hope that's you.</p></div><h1><strong>About the role</strong></h1> <p><strong>Impact</strong><strong><br></strong>Most of our UK investment to date has gone into winning patients. This role owns what happens next — whether they stay, whether they grow, and whether the revenue they generate is actually profitable. You will own <strong>Repeat Contribution Margin</strong> for the UK: repeat revenue minus the variable cost to serve it, across Hims and Hers in weight-loss, hair, sexual health and TRT. It is a single number and it is yours. You'll report to the Managing Director, UK and sit alongside the two brand Directors of Growth, who own new patient acquisition.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own UK Repeat Contribution Margin</strong> — both halves: repeat revenue <em>and</em> the variable cost to serve, including retention-linked COGS. Commercial sets the P&amp;L target and owns the model and guardrails; you choose the levers within it, build the plan, and land the number.</li> <li><strong>Run the monetisation portfolio</strong> — expansion levers (cross-sell across conditions, service packages and premium tiers, Shop and physical add-ons, paid diagnostics for existing patients) and margin-protection levers (upsell to commit-and-save plans, titration and maintenance plans, cancellation saves, reactivation, loyalty). Decide where to invest, size the prize, and kill what isn't working.</li> <li><strong>Own churn and save economics</strong> — cancellation saves, reactivation and win-back. Churn modelling and automated save offers are already in flight; your job is to turn that into a governed P&amp;L lever and to prove incrementality rather than bank credit for patients who'd have returned anyway.</li> <li><strong>Own the whole post-purchase journey</strong> — from activation through to lifetime. Where Proposition defines and builds a new offer for a core category, operational execution post-purchase hands off to you.</li> <li><strong>Lead a condition-level retention team of four</strong> — a Head of Retention for weight-loss across both brands (with a Strategy &amp; Ops Lead beneath them), plus S&amp;O Leads for Hair/Sex and for TRT, the latter including activation ops from blood test to first order. Build the bench and raise the bar.</li> <li><strong>Direct the central and shared functions without managing them</strong> — you decide and brief; CRM, Patient Support, Clinical Ops, Clinical Outcomes and Product build. You set the experience standard, approve the SLA and cost line, and hold each function to its impact. You will not set clinical protocol, and you will need to be effective without line authority.</li> <li><strong>Surface, prioritise and win the product roadmap</strong> — turn retention friction into a prioritised requirement list with a business case, and pitch it to the MD against acquisition work that is easier to justify.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What good looks like.</strong> A first six months that delivers a Repeat Contribution Margin baseline everyone trusts, condition-level cost attribution phased in behind it, two or three monetisation levers live with clean reads, and a save programme that survives an incrementality test.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>About you</h2> <h3>Skills &amp; experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>You have 10-12 years of experience across D2C brands </strong>running P&amp;Ls and owning commercial targets.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You've owned a repeat-revenue or contribution-margin number in a subscription or repeat-purchase consumer business</strong> — not influenced it, owned it. You can talk through the plan you set, what you got wrong, and what you'd do differently.</li> <li><strong>You've built a monetisation portfolio, not just run retention campaigns.</strong> Pricing and packaging, upsell and cross-sell, plan structures, loyalty — you've decided what to build, sized it, and killed the ones that didn't earn their place.</li> <li><strong>You are commercially and analytically rigorous on the cost side.</strong> You understand contribution margin properly, you've worked with imperfect cost attribution and made decisions anyway, and you hold a hard line on incrementality — including when a flattering headline number is on offer.</li> <li><strong>You've delivered through functions you don't manage.</strong> CRM, support, ops, clinical, product. You know how to set a standard, agree an SLA, and hold people to impact using influence and evidence rather than reporting lines.</li> <li><strong>You've led and built a small senior team</strong> — hired well, levelled honestly, and given people real ownership of sub-numbers.</li> <li><strong>You operate at pace in ambiguity and bring your own point of view.</strong> This role has no playbook at Euc. You'll be expected to anchor the direction rather than wait for the MD or Commercial to set the agenda.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to haves</h3> <ul> <li>Healthcare, or another regulated, trust-based consumer category where what you can say and offer is genuinely constrained.</li> <li>Experience across more than one market — Germany mirrors this model as it matures, and weight-loss retention may become EMEA-wide.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3066 - Paid Social Senior Associate Director - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>The Paid Social, Senior Account Associate Director is the paid social lead for designated clients/campaigns and is responsible for delivering category-defining capabilities and services across all Biddable channels, with a particular focus on paid social activity. Success in this role involves providing strategic insight across a breadth of channels, helping to evolve best practice within the paid social channel specifically, and leading a team (including ultimate responsibility for quality of work within this team).</p> <ul> <li>Responsible for effective oversight of designated account campaigns and weaving these into the overall cross-channel campaign strategy ​</li> <li>Support the team Client Director &amp; Media Activation Practice Lead in capacity planning &amp; resource management for the team​</li> <li>Oversea development and creation of paid social best practices in region coordinating with global EMEA / APAC team to ensure consistency across regions (with ultimate accountability for adherence to controls and best practices across all channels in the immediate account team)​</li> <li>Be the primary contact point of contact between the Media Activation team and regular stakeholders both internal &amp; external for their account(s)​</li> <li>Develop strong relationships with your client, and key suppliers, leading team communications with these stakeholders. Be able to communicate with clients on subjects outside your remit, and provide them with useful insight, working independently​</li> <li>Develop in-depth knowledge of all paid social platforms and related bid-management platforms, and other methods of buying paid social (e.g. including programmatically-bought via DSPs) operating as in-agency expert in your field of specialism, whilst showing a good understanding of the overall media landscape​</li> <li>Manage and develop vendor relationships within paid social, working closely with the Platforms &amp; Emerging Media team where applicable​</li> <li>Identifying new platforms, partners &amp; integrations, evaluating these (and existing platforms) over time and maintaining a POV here​</li> <li>Develop thought leadership pieces &amp; case studies throughout the course of the year to demonstrate role within wider industry as a display expert​</li> <li>Deliver quarterly, semi-annual, or annual updates on work quality as it relates to owned workstreams</li> <li>Responsible for effective oversight of designated account campaigns and weaving these into the overall cross-channel campaign strategy</li> <li>Support the team Client Director &amp; Media Activation Practice Lead in capacity planning &amp; resource management for the team</li> <li>Oversea development and creation of paid social best practices in region coordinating with global EMEA / APAC team to ensure consistency across regions (with ultimate accountability for adherence to controls and best practices across all channels in the immediate account team)</li> <li>Be the primary contact point of contact between the Media Activation team and regular stakeholders both internal &amp; external for their account(s)</li> <li>Develop strong relationships with your client, and key suppliers, leading team communications with these stakeholders. Be able to communicate with clients on subjects outside your remit, and provide them with useful insight, working independently</li> <li>Develop in-depth knowledge of all paid social platforms and related bid-management platforms, and other methods of buying paid social (e.g. including programmatically-bought via DSPs) operating as in-agency expert in your field of specialism, whilst showing a good understanding of the overall media landscape</li> <li>Manage and develop vendor relationships within paid social, working closely with the Platforms &amp; Emerging Media team where applicable</li> <li>Identifying new platforms, partners &amp; integrations, evaluating these (and existing platforms) over time and maintaining a POV here</li> <li>Develop thought leadership pieces &amp; case studies throughout the course of the year to demonstrate role within wider industry as a display expert</li> <li>Deliver quarterly, semi-annual, or annual updates on work quality as it relates to owned workstreams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP &amp; WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> <li>Proven experience at Activation Director level in a Digital Media or Advertising role (including some aspects of managing P&amp;L)​</li> <li>Proven Project Management, Leadership and People Management Experience​</li> <li>Experience with planning and running large-scale paid social activity on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn, either directly or via third party platforms​</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of media planning fundamentals e.g. reach, frequency, channels, formats, etc.​</li> <li>Experience of managing paid social vendor relationships​</li> <li>Regularly contributes to paid social best practices and campaign processes​</li> <li>End of quarter wrap up and review content for biddable campaigns.​</li> <li>Responsible for Biddable media planning and strategy​</li> <li>Experience with Google Analytics (plus certification) desirable​</li> <li>Experience with programmatically-bought paid social activity desirable ​</li> <li>Some experience with paid search, programmatic display &amp; reservation-based buying desirable</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.<br><br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Partner Success Manager, EMEA
description: Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business. We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn. This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is expected two days per week on Tuesdays and Thursdays in London. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events. Ironclad is scaling rapidly across EMEA through a partner-first go-to-market model. We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, proactive EMEA Partner Success Manager to shape and operationalise our Global Partner Services programs—building effective partner engagement, enablement, readiness, and collaboration across the region. As part of Customer Value, you’ll support partner services across the customer lifecycle, from pre-sales alignment and delivery readiness through co-delivery and post-live adoption. Working with major systems integrators and consulting firms, you’ll help evolve a value-focused model that starts earlier in the customer journey and extends beyond implementation to improve conversion, accelerate time to value, increase platform usage, and strengthen long-term customer outcomes. You’ll bring a strong operator’s mindset: turning ambiguity into clear, repeatable ways of working across Sales, Alliances, Technical Services, Customer Success, and external partners. You’ll use data to improve program performance and, based in London, spend regular time in the office and face-to-face with partners to build relationships and help them succeed. What you'll do: Own relationships with strategic partners’ practice and delivery leaders, aligning on priorities, readiness, quality expectations, capacity, and growth opportunities. Partner with Sales, Alliances, and Customer Value to match qualified opportunities with the right partner, co-delivery model, and implementation approach based on customer needs, deal context, partner readiness, and expectations. Operationalise partner engagement across the customer lifecycle—from discovery and scoping through readiness planning, delivery transition, and post-live support—clarifying roles and setting engagements up for execution and adoption. Evolve partner programs with Partner Alliances, Enablement, and Customer Value leadership, including co-delivery and subcontracting frameworks, onboarding, certification, methodology alignment, delivery quality, and ongoing enablement. Assess partner capacity, coverage, skills, and readiness against business demand and EMEA growth priorities; coordinate capacity planning across strategic and subcontracting relationships to improve predictability. Build targeted partner enablement plans across product knowledge, implementation, integrations, value selling, customer change management, AI use cases, and emerging AI consumption models; help partners adapt capabilities and commercial/delivery approaches as opportunities evolve. Work with EA and partner teams to understand partner ISV offerings, technology ecosystems, integrations, and customer architecture requirements, and connect differentiated capabilities to customer opportunities. Help partner-led engagements establish a path to customer enablement, adoption, value realisation, and sustained platform usage after go-live; reinforce accountability for agreed post-live milestones. Identify patterns in partner-led work that affect conversion, delivery quality, time to value, adoption health, renewal readiness, and expansion potential; translate findings into practical program improvements. Establish an EMEA partner operating rhythm (in partnership with EMEA Partner Alliances) —including business reviews, readiness and capacity assessments, enablement planning, and escalation management—and keep partners current on regional priorities, market dynamics, customer needs, and product and go-to-market changes. Maintain operational hygiene and data integrity for partner-led projects and programs across internal systems, reporting, and workflows; translate feedback from European partners and customers into actionable recommendations for Ironclad teams. What success looks like: A scalable EMEA partner-first operating model and a clear, consistent operating rhythm. Better alignment between partner strategy and qualified deal motions, with greater confidence in partner fit, readiness, and implementation approach before kickoff. More predictable partner capacity and targeted capability plans, with priority enablement gaps owned and closed. Consistent, high-quality partner-led and co-delivered services, with clear roles across EA, Sales, Alliances, Services, Customer Value, and partners. Partners equipped to respond to EMEA priorities and AI-led opportunities; partner ISV and integration capabilities connected to relevant customer needs. Improved customer time to value, adoption, sustained usage, and expansion outcomes, with a positive contribution to adoption health, GRR, and NDR-oriented outcomes. What we're looking for: 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Partner Operations, Customer Success, Implementation, or a related role at a SaaS company and/or consulting or systems integration firm. 2+ years of experience working with implementation partners, subcontractors, or partner delivery teams in a services environment. Experience supporting complex pre-sales, scoping, or solution-alignment motions with Sales, Services, and/or Alliances teams; implementation, managed, partner services, or GSI experience is highly relevant. Strong program management skills and a track record of building or improving cross-functional processes spanning internal teams and external partners. Ability to bring structure to ambiguity and execute repeatable operating models in a fast-changing environment. Strong relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills, including the ability to work with senior stakeholders across functions and geographies and turn complex considerations into clear recommendations. Comfort using data and KPIs to evaluate program effectiveness and improve conversion, delivery quality, adoption, and customer outcomes. Experience with change management, adoption planning, or value realisation is strongly preferred; understanding how to set partners up across sales, delivery, enablement, integrations, and customer outcomes is important. Entrepreneurial mindset, sound judgment, and comfort shaping a partner-first model as the business scales and the operating model evolves. Willingness to spend regular time in the London office and travel across Europe (approximately 15%). Fluency in an additional European language, particularly German or French, is beneficial but not required.
