title: Data Instructor  (Internal)
description: Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption. We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce. Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance. In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn. But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output. Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. The Opportunity As an instructor, you will be responsible for the delivery of our technical content and supporting our apprentices in upskilling in these technical areas through workshops and drop in sessions. You will help apprentices develop the appropriate Knowledge, Skills & Behaviours throughout their programme. The Multiverse delivery team is a diverse mix of industry experts, educators, and academics, working together to build the future of work. You will be part of this team, reporting to a Delivery Lead who will guide your development. To ensure a strong start, you will complete a 3-week onboarding programme, covering: Modern teaching methodologies - for a hands-on, engaging learning experience Technical upskilling - to align with the relevant apprenticeship standard Practical coaching opportunities - a rigorous, robust feedback process to get you ready to launch your programme At the end of onboarding, you will be ready to support Multiverse apprentices, helping them develop technical expertise and industry-relevant skills relating to AI and Data domains and drive impact within their businesses. We believe this is an opportunity like no other! Specifically, you will: Confidently facilitate delivery sessions of our technical Learning content, ensuring the session delivers against learning objectives within the allotted time. Adhere to the Coach Quality framework to ensure a consistent level of quality for every session and a consistent experience for every apprentice. Create a vibrant, inclusive and motivating environment that drives apprentice learning, engagement and overall satisfaction. Moderate assignments in line with mark schemes to ensure quality and consistency while providing feedback and feed forward for apprentices to continually develop their technical and durable skills. Maintain an owners mentality, whether assigned a learner or in support of other coaches, being proactive in taking action, sharing feedback, or providing support to ensure the progress and success of learners. Regularly liaise with coaches to align on apprentice interventions to ensure successful completion of programme. Coordinate with cohort coaches and operations members to align on apprentice development and progress. Utilise resources & learning opportunities provided by Multiverse, stay up-to-date on knowledge, learning and product updates, to ensure you are equipped to support your apprentices. Build & maintain credibility with your apprentices by utilising a mixture of professional experience, program/domain/industry knowledge and client context in your interactions. Create a compelling narrative about Multiverse, our mission, and the pillars of our offering, and help apprentices connect to it through the duration of their apprenticeship, and beyond. About you: You possess strong written and on-camera communication and presentation skills. You can skilfully adjust communication approaches to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. You can think critically and solve problems as they arise, especially in an online classroom setting. You are committed to continuous professional development and staying current with industry trends. Proficient in at least two of the following: Excel for BI, Tableau, Power BI Skilled in SQL and ideally Python, demonstrated through real-world projects. Practical knowledge of predictive modelling (e.g., regression, decision trees) and time series forecasting (e.g., SARIMA). Solid understanding of statistical methods and their applications. Proven experience applying data and advanced analytics in professional settings Strong advocate for ethical and responsible data use, with hands-on experience in data governance and knowledge of data protection laws This is a full time, permanent opportunity to join the Multiverse team. Benefits Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year Health & Wellness - private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked! Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here . Our Commitment to Safeguarding Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy , our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS). For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings. As an instructor, you will be responsible for the delivery of our technical content and supporting our apprentices in upskilling in these technical areas through workshops and drop in sessions. The Multiverse delivery team is a diverse mix of industry experts, educators, and academics, working together to build the future of work. You will be part of this team, reporting to a Delivery Lead who will guide your development.

To ensure a strong start, you will complete a 3-week onboarding programme, covering:

  • Modern teaching methodologies - for a hands-on, engaging learning experience

  • Technical upskilling - to align with the relevant apprenticeship standard

  • Practical coaching opportunities - a rigorous, robust feedback process to get you ready to launch your programme

At the end of onboarding, you will be ready to support Multiverse apprentices, helping them develop technical expertise and industry-relevant skills relating to AI and Data domains and drive impact within their businesses. We believe this is an opportunity like no other!

Specifically, you will:

  • Confidently facilitate delivery sessions of our technical Learning content, ensuring the session delivers against learning objectives within the allotted time.

  • Adhere to the Coach Quality framework to ensure a consistent level of quality for every session and a consistent experience for every apprentice.

  • Create a vibrant, inclusive and motivating environment that drives apprentice learning, engagement and overall satisfaction.

  • Moderate assignments in line with mark schemes to ensure quality and consistency while providing feedback and feed forward for apprentices to continually develop their technical and durable skills.

  • Practical knowledge of predictive modelling (e.g., regression, decision trees) and time series forecasting (e.g., SARIMA).

  • Strong advocate for ethical and responsible data use, with hands-on experience in data governance and knowledge of data protection laws

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

raw.title: Head of Growth
raw.description:
The role

The Head of Growth owns every paid route to a new TALA customer. You will set the acquisition strategy, own the media budget and be measured on the new customers it brings in. The role leads the Growth pillar of the Digital & Customer team, and is central to taking TALA from c. £30m to £100m+ in revenue.

You will lead a small in-house team and our agency partners, work closely with brand, creative and the Customer and Digital Experience teams, and grow TALA into new channels and new markets.

What you will be accountable for

You will be responsible for new customer growth and the efficiency of every pound spent to acquire it.

  • Deliver new customer volume, CAC and first-order contribution targets across all paid channels

  • Own the acquisition budget and its allocation across channels, markets and campaigns against CAC, ROAS, blended MER and payback

  • Build the annual and in-season acquisition plan with finance, including new customer targets, media budgets and forecasts

  • Grow the share of high-value new customers, working with your peers in the customer team on cohort and lifetime value data

  • Report weekly and monthly on acquisition performance, trade-offs and recommendations to the Digital & Customer Director and leadership team

Paid media and channels

  • Own paid social across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Snapchat, including prospecting, retargeting and creator partnership ads

  • Own paid search and shopping, including brand, non-brand and Performance Max

  • Own video and programmatic, using upper-funnel media to build reach and demand alongside direct response

  • Own affiliates and partnerships, including publisher, content and strategic brand partners

  • Run a structured test, learn and scale approach to new channels, such as TikTok Shop

  • Build TALA's visibility in AI search and shopping, including ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode, working with the Head of Digital Experience

  • Manage the trading calendar for paid media around launches, drops, collaborations and key promotional moments, with merchandising and brand

Measurement and insight

  • Own the acquisition measurement framework, combining platform data, attribution, incrementality testing and media mix modelling

  • Run an ongoing programme of incrementality tests, including geo-lift and holdout studies, and use the results to set budgets

  • Measure the effect of paid media on store sales as well as online, as TALA becomes more omnichannel

  • Work with the Head of Digital Experience on tracking, attribution and server-side data, so the numbers are trusted across the business

  • Partner with finance and the data team on a single view of CAC, MER and payback

Creative and brand

  • Partner with the brand and creative teams on performance creative, setting briefs from channel and audience insight

  • Build a high-volume creative testing programme across formats, hooks and talent, and feed the results back into brand and product

  • Use AI tools to increase the volume and speed of creative production and testing, keeping all work on brand

  • Work closely with the Brand Marketing Director on PR, influencer, creator and community activity, and put paid spend behind what works

  • Protect the TALA brand in every paid placement, balancing short-term returns with long-term brand building

New markets and growth

  • Lead paid acquisition for international market launches, from test budgets and localisation to scaling in each market

  • Support store openings, including Edinburgh, with local awareness and footfall campaigns

  • Work with the Customer team on referral, reactivation and lapsed-customer acquisition

  • Partner with the Head of Digital Experience on landing pages, conversion and SEO, so paid traffic converts

Team and agency leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a small team of acquisition specialists

  • Decide the right mix of in-house capability and agency partners, and manage agency relationships, briefs, fees and performance

  • Manage the growth technology stack, including attribution, analytics, affiliate and creative tools, with clear return on each

  • Lead the use of AI across the growth function, building it into media buying, budget allocation, creative, analysis and reporting

  • Build the team's AI skills, with the right tools, training and clear guidelines on brand, data and privacy

  • Build a culture of experimentation, pace and ownership of results

  • Stay hands-on in the platforms and the numbers

About you

You are a commercial growth marketer who has scaled paid acquisition for a fast-growing consumer brand. You are as comfortable in a contribution model as you are in Ads Manager, and you’re equally passionate about our brand and product as you are about working in one of the fastest-paced disciplines in marketing.

Experience

  • 8-10+ years in performance or growth marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team, ideally in high-growth DTC fashion, activewear or beauty

  • A proven record of scaling new customer acquisition profitably, ideally in a business growing from £20m+ towards £100m+

  • Ownership of a multi-million pound annual media budget across several channels

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in paid social and paid search, and experience across video, programmatic and affiliates

  • Experience with incrementality testing, media mix modelling and multi-touch attribution, and using them to make budget decisions

  • Experience launching paid media in new international markets

  • A strong understanding of performance creative and creator-led advertising

  • Experience selecting and managing agency partners and growth technology

  • A track record of using AI to improve marketing performance and efficiency, including AI-led buying such as Meta Advantage+ and Performance Max, creative production and analysis

  • Experience leading a team through AI adoption, with measurable gains in output, speed or cost

  • Strong working knowledge of Shopify, GA4 and attribution tools

Competencies

  • Commercially sharp: thinks in CAC, payback and contribution, and makes budget calls on marginal return

  • Analytical: highly numerate, tests and measures everything, and questions the data

  • Customer-focused: understands who the customer is, what they respond to and what they are worth

  • Brand-minded: builds the TALA brand through paid media as well as driving sales

  • Entrepreneurial: moves at pace, works lean and thrives in a high-growth environment

  • Collaborative: works across brand, creative, product, merchandising and finance, and brings people with them

  • Leader and communicator: develops talent and explains performance clearly to senior leadership

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays

  • Very generous employee discount after probation period

  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount

  • Clothing allowance spending gift

  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership

  • Health Shield

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay

  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

raw.title: HIL Engineer — Huracan Rocket Engine
raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

 

About the role

The Exploration Company is developing Huracan, a cryogenic rocket engine. The engine integrates e-pumps, power electronics, valves, embedded software, and control systems. We are seeking a Hardware-in-the-Loop Engineer to develop and operate HIL platforms for verifying the ECU, PDU, Valve Controller, inverter, electric pumps, and associated software. You will connect real hardware to real-time simulations, automate testing and data analysis, and develop emulator hardware for sensors, actuators, interfaces, and subsystem behaviour.

You will verify nominal and fault conditions while ensuring test repeatability, traceability, and early fault detection. You will work closely with propulsion, embedded-software, power-electronics, control-systems, and hardware engineers to validate Huracan from simulation through laboratory testing.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain the HIL test environment for our engine propulsion system, from engine controller board level up to the integrated propulsion subsystem

  • Define and implement the hardware and software architecture of the propulsion HIL bench, including signal conditioning, load and fault-insertion hardware, and real-time targets

  • Integrate real-time plant models (e.g., feed system, valves, pumps and motors, combustion chamber, thermal behaviour) into NI VeriStand and close the loop with the engine control unit

  • Emulate and simulate the sensors the controller depends on (e.g., pressure transducers, thermocouples and RTDs, flow meters, position and speed feedback) with flight-representative electrical characteristics

  • Emulate or integrate actuators and power electronics, such as valve drivers, motor inverters, igniters, and their control units, as real hardware, electrical loads, or models

  • Develop LabVIEW-based applications for desktop and real-time platforms (e.g., PXI, cRIO), including custom devices and bus interfaces (e.g., CAN, RS-422/485, Ethernet)

  • Implement fault injection at the electrical and model level to verify engine start-up, shutdown, and abort sequences as well as FDIR behaviour

  • Support test execution, data acquisition, logging, and automated reporting during verification campaigns

  • Validate and correlate simulation models against component-level and engine test data together with the propulsion team

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture specifications, interface definitions, model and code documentation, and user guides

  • Debug and troubleshoot across the bench, the models, and the unit under test, and continuously improve the test platform

You will be in charge of

  • Delivering a robust and scalable HIL platform whose models, I/O configuration, and test sequences can be reused across engine configurations and projects

  • Running control loops and plant models deterministically at the rates the engine controller requires, using NI hardware, LabVIEW RT, and FPGA where timing demands it

  • Defining test automation workflows using NI TestStand and integrating them into the propulsion and system-level verification process

  • Coordinating closely with propulsion, avionics, and flight software engineers to ensure requirements traceability and test coverage

  • Keeping models, bench hardware, and test software under configuration control so that every test run is reproducible

  • Contributing to the continuous evolution of our HiL infrastructure, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and maintainability

  • Ensuring all solutions meet space-grade quality and safety standards, aligned with project requirements

Must-Have Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Control Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience building and operating HIL test benches for closed-loop control systems (e.g., engine, motor, or actuator controllers)

  • Proficiency in LabVIEW, including desktop and real-time application development

  • Hands-on experience with NI VeriStand in real-time test environments, including integration of simulation models (e.g., Simulink, FMU, or C/C++)

  • Experience emulating sensors and actuators at the electrical level (e.g., analog, thermocouple/RTD, frequency and PWM, discrete I/O) and working with motor drives or inverters

  • Familiarity with NI TestStand for test automation and execution management

  • Solid understanding of test platform architectures, hardware/software integration, and real-time systems

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with a structured and methodical approach

  • Ability to write and integrate Python scripts to extend test workflows or support automation tasks

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with LabVIEW FPGA, for example for high-speed sensor emulation or motor and inverter simulation

  • Background in liquid rocket propulsion or in fluid and thermal system modelling

  • Experience with fault-insertion hardware and FDIR verification

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards or equivalent aerospace standards such as DO-178C

  • Experience supporting engine or integrated system test campaigns

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

About the role

Mirakl is looking for a senior contractor to join its Finance team and provide operational leadership in an international, multi-entity environment.

Reporting to the Accounting & Tax Director, you will secure the continuity and quality of day-to-day accounting operations while supporting the monthly and annual close.

The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the Finance function, particularly through the identification, testing and adoption of relevant automation and AI use cases. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to process improvement and change management.

Contractor

6 months

Start: ASAP 

Location: Paris or Bordeaux (aller-retour à prévoir à Bordeaux 1 fois par mois)

Key responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay

  • Own and coordinate the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier creation and invoice receipt through to validation, booking and payment.
  • Coordinate the Accounts Payable team and ensure timely processing of invoices across Mirakl's entities.
  • Monitor invoice workflows, approvals, purchase orders, blocked invoices and outstanding supplier balances.
  • Review invoice coding, supporting documentation and accounting treatment, and act as an escalation point for complex supplier issues.
  • Coordinate payment runs and ensure that payment files are prepared accurately and in line with internal approval procedures.
  • Maintain robust controls over vendor master data, bank details, payment approvals and segregation of duties.

Accounting operations and close support

  • Support the Accounting & Tax Director in the coordination of the monthly and annual close process.
  • Review AP-related cut-off and other accounting entries.
  • Monitor the reconciliation and clean-up of relevant balance sheet accounts and support the review of intercompany transactions.
  • Coordinate with local accounting firms and external service providers across Mirakl's international perimeter.
  • Contribute to audit preparation and respond to requests from external auditors and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure that accounting evidence, procedures and control documentation are complete, accessible and up to date.

Finance transformation, automation and AI

  • Contribute to Mirakl's Finance AI transformation roadmap by identifying high-value use cases within AP, Procure-to-Pay and accounting operations.
  • Participate in discovery phases, workshops and experiments aimed at improving invoice processing, data quality, reconciliations, reporting and operational support.
  • Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders.
  • Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives.
  • Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working.
  • Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes.

Candidate profile

  • 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management
  • Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director
  • Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls.
  • Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries.
  • Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems
  • Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases.
  • Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills.
  • Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage.

raw.title: Deputy Accounting Director (freelance/contractor)
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

About the role

Mirakl is looking for a senior contractor to join its Finance team and provide operational leadership in an international, multi-entity environment.

Reporting to the Accounting & Tax Director, you will secure the continuity and quality of day-to-day accounting operations while supporting the monthly and annual close.

The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the transformation of the Finance function, particularly through the identification, testing and adoption of relevant automation and AI use cases. The successful candidate will combine strong accounting expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to process improvement and change management.

Contractor

6 months

Start: ASAP 

Location: Paris or Bordeaux (aller-retour à prévoir à Bordeaux 1 fois par mois)

Key responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay

  • Own and coordinate the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier creation and invoice receipt through to validation, booking and payment.
  • Coordinate the Accounts Payable team and ensure timely processing of invoices across Mirakl's entities.
  • Monitor invoice workflows, approvals, purchase orders, blocked invoices and outstanding supplier balances.
  • Review invoice coding, supporting documentation and accounting treatment, and act as an escalation point for complex supplier issues.
  • Coordinate payment runs and ensure that payment files are prepared accurately and in line with internal approval procedures.
  • Maintain robust controls over vendor master data, bank details, payment approvals and segregation of duties.

Accounting operations and close support

  • Support the Accounting & Tax Director in the coordination of the monthly and annual close process.
  • Review AP-related cut-off and other accounting entries.
  • Monitor the reconciliation and clean-up of relevant balance sheet accounts and support the review of intercompany transactions.
  • Coordinate with local accounting firms and external service providers across Mirakl's international perimeter.
  • Contribute to audit preparation and respond to requests from external auditors and other stakeholders.
  • Ensure that accounting evidence, procedures and control documentation are complete, accessible and up to date.

Finance transformation, automation and AI

  • Contribute to Mirakl's Finance AI transformation roadmap by identifying high-value use cases within AP, Procure-to-Pay and accounting operations.
  • Participate in discovery phases, workshops and experiments aimed at improving invoice processing, data quality, reconciliations, reporting and operational support.
  • Help assess and test AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions and Finance agents, working closely with Finance, Data and other stakeholders.
  • Translate operational requirements into clear process, data and control requirements for automation and AI initiatives.
  • Support the adoption of new tools by documenting processes, defining operating guidelines, monitoring results and helping teams embed new ways of working.
  • Remain attentive to data quality, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight and appropriate controls when using AI in Finance processes.

Candidate profile

  • 8+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or accounting management
  • Previous experience as an Accounting Manager, Deputy Accounting Director
  • Experience in a multi-entity, international environment; experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company is a strong advantage.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, closing processes, cut-off, reconciliations and internal controls.
  • Experience working with external accounting firms and international subsidiaries.
  • Strong knowledge of ERP and finance systems
  • Interest in Finance transformation, automation and AI, with the ability to translate operational needs into practical use cases.
  • Autonomous, hands-on and solution-oriented, with excellent organisational, analytical and communication skills.
  • Fluent English required; French is a strong advantage.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

title: Regional Sales Director - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Director of Regional Sales for France, you'll take ownership of building and leading our Italian sales presence. You'll drive revenue growth, implement disciplined sales processes and technology, and partner across account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations to deliver exceptional customer experiences. You'll report to the VP of Sales and balance hands-on field leadership with strategic vision. You'll stay close to key accounts, develop your sales team, and expand our client base. In this role, you'll be passionate about open source software, drive repeatable sales processes, and influence GitLab's growth by establishing disciplined go-to-market strategies, developing sales talent, and executing against ambitious bookings targets in France.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead the growth of GitLab's business in France, taking ownership for building the country plan, pipeline discipline, and day-to-day execution to achieve or exceed quarterly bookings and ARR growth targets.</li> <li value="2">Manage, coach, and develop a small team of Account Executives, staying close to the field, joining customer meetings, and modeling hands-on, high-activity sales behaviour.</li> <li value="3">Drive new logo acquisition across a broad base of medium-sized Italian businesses while shaping a long-term strategy to engage larger accounts.</li> <li value="4">Build GitLab’s reputation in the Italian market by partnering with marketing, business development, and local networks to generate pipeline and increase market awareness.</li> <li value="5">Establish clear operating rhythms, sales processes, and methodologies that bring structure, organization, and accountability to the team without losing agility.</li> <li value="6">Collaborate with regional sales leaders and cross-functional partners across account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations to align territory coverage, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution across the region.</li> <li value="7">Develop and maintain strong relationships with key accounts at the executive level (CXO and program level), positioning GitLab as a strategic partner and identifying expansion opportunities.</li> <li value="8">Analyze pipeline, forecast, and performance data to identify gaps and opportunities, adjust plans so the team focuses on the highest-impact activities, and represent the Italian business internally by sharing insights on market trends, customer needs, and resource requirements to inform regional strategy.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience building and leading high-performing sales teams, ideally within France, with a focus on coaching and developing talent.</li> <li value="2">Ability to design and execute a country go-to-market plan, including pipeline generation discipline, territory coverage, and disciplined deal execution.</li> <li value="3">Strength in balancing hands-on field work with strategic leadership, staying close to customers while managing day-to-day operations.</li> <li value="4">Familiarity with B2B software or technology sales and open source/DevSecOps concepts, with enthusiasm for learning GitLab’s platform and building long-term market presence.</li> <li value="5">Skills in creating structure, setting clear expectations, and driving organized, data-informed sales processes, including use of MEDDPICC or similar methodologies.</li> <li value="6">Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to create trust and empathy with both customers and GitLab team members at all levels.</li> <li value="7">Comfort operating in a dynamic, growth-focused, all-remote environment, acting as a self-directed “manager of one” and using Salesforce.com or similar CRM and marketing automation systems to build trackable, repeatable sales processes.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You’ll join a regional sales organization focused on growing GitLab’s presence across France, working closely with Account Executives and cross-functional partners in account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations. The team is all-remote and collaborates asynchronously across time zones to build pipeline, manage complex sales cycles, and deliver consistent customer experiences. You’ll help shape how we organize coverage, implement disciplined sales processes, and bring structure to a high-growth region while staying aligned with global sales strategy and GitLab’s values of transparency, collaboration, and results.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-BC2</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human<br><br></strong>Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.<br><br>This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.</p></div><p><strong>Get to know Okta</strong><strong><br></strong>Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Auth0 and Okta Platforms enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.</p> <p>At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box, we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.&nbsp;</p> <p>Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Okta Technical Account Management Team</strong></p> <p>The TAM team empowers Okta customers to deliver secure, scalable, and transformative identity solutions by acting as their trusted identity coach. We drive lasting success through elevated technical maturity, proactively guiding their identity decisions and long-term identity vision. We guide a customer’s strategy for customer identity, workforce identity, and security posture while driving value in Okta’s suite of products and, ultimately, retention at contract renewal.</p> <p><strong>The Auth0 Technical Account Manager Opportunity</strong></p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical expert to join the TAM team. This role specialises in the Auth0 platform, which is an easy-to-implement, adaptable authentication and authorization platform for Consumer and SaaS applications. Basically, we make your login experience awesome. You will be working with a portfolio of well-known brands on their Auth0 implementations as an identity coach. Building close relationships with technical stakeholders from early in the customer lifecycle, you will learn their business, goals, challenges and technical landscape, ensuring Okta delivers on a long-term strategic plan to help solve these challenges and realize the value of their Auth0 platform investment, while continuing to evolve to solve new objectives and improve security posture.</p> <p>The ideal candidate for this role is competent with both technical delivery and customer business-facing engagement, preferably with experience in identity and security. They showcase both interest and adaptability to Identity, SDLC, and SaaS discussions, including agility in unpredictable customer interactions, with technical accuracy top of mind.</p> <p><br><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted Identity Coach, guiding customers to achieve their objectives through timely technical guidance, advice, enablement, and best practice sharing</li> <li>Learn our customers’ business deeply, gaining deep insights into their strategies, goals, and challenges - through the lens of identity</li> <li>Build and nurture long-term relationships with stakeholder personas from developers, engineering leads, app builders, and product owners, through to C-level exec, evolving customers into Auth0 champions</li> technical practitioners on identity solutions, technical guidance and best practices</li> <li>Monitor customer health, satisfaction, and engagement, proactively addressing risks and escalations</li> <li>Collaborate with stakeholders to develop strategies to increase customer adoption, and uncover growth opportunities that will solidify Auth0 for the entirety of customer identity</li> <li>Analyze trends, identify areas for improvement, and take action to optimize customer outcomes</li> <li>Act as a product evangelist, educating customers on new features and alignment of roadmaps to enhance their experience</li> <li>Represent the voice of the customer, ensuring their needs and feedback shape the company’s approach</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of total experience in information technology, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience as a Technical Account Manager (or comparable technical practitioner role) in the customer identity/identity access management space</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French and comfortable communicating with French-speaking customers and stakeholders.</strong></li> <li>Working proficiency in the following core CIAM areas or technical competencies:&nbsp;</li> <ul> <li>Technologies and protocols to support authentication and authorization (OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2.0)</li> <li>Consuming APIs and HTTP request methods</li> <li>High-level understanding of custom consumer and SaaS apps both web and native, including their architecture, user experience considerations, and common integration patterns</li> <li>Security and performance monitoring, and 3rd party signals integrations (SIEM, WAF, etc)</li> <li>Understanding of the general cybersecurity landscape with respect to threats and challenges</li> <li>Experience with SaaS/PaaS/cloud-based services, driving their adoption, integration, and ongoing use</li> <li>Understanding of software development lifecycle and application builder practices</li> </ul> <li>A customer-first mindset with the energy and problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and achieve customers' business and technical objectives</li> <li>Strong business acumen, history of success owning enterprise segment customer relationships and escalations</li> <li>Ability to track and manage the moving parts of multiple parallel initiatives or projects</li> <li>Strong presentation and whiteboarding/diagram skills</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to set expectations, and communicate goals and objectives with customers at various levels, from a developer to C-level exec</li> <li>Ability to influence customer behaviour &amp; health metrics across a portfolio of customers</li> <li>This position may be located in Dublin with some travel required (under 25% of the time)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location:</strong>&nbsp;This position can be based in either our&nbsp;<strong>London or Paris office</strong>, with some travel required (under 25% of the time).</p> <p>#LI-RB4<br>#LI-HYBRID</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>The Okta Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="http://rewards.okta.com">Supporting Your href="https://www.okta.com/company/talent-connection-community/">Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community</a></li> </ul> <p>We are intentional about connection. Arkane Cloud Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais qui rend la puissance de calcul IA accessible, abordable et disponible en quelques minutes. Grâce à notre propre infrastructure GPU, startups, chercheurs et entreprises déploient leurs modèles d’IA sans se battre avec la technique : Jusqu’à 70 % d’économies par rapport à un hyperscaler. Une plateforme Plug & Play prête en moins de 3 minutes. Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA. Pourquoi ce poste ? Spécialisé dans l’IA-as-a-Service et GPU-as-a-Service, nous avons une infrastructure allant d'A5000 jusqu’au NVIDIA HGX B300 (InfiniBand XDR, stockage VAST Data). Nous créons ce poste pour nous accompagner dans les futurs déploiements, puis multiplier les clusters et les sites, avec une équipe qui grandit en parallèle. C’est un poste de bâtisseur : vous êtes responsable de l’infrastructure de bout en bout, de la commande du matériel au GPU disponible pour le client. Vos missions Concevoir et déployer les clusters GPU (HGX B300, GB300, Vera Rubin) selon les référence architectures NVIDIA. Porter le réseau et le stockage : InfiniBand XDR, RoCE v2, connectivité externe, VAST Data. Choisir et négocier data centers et fournisseurs : colocation, énergie, refroidissement liquide, NVIDIA, OEM, intégrateurs. Tenir le SLA : supervision, astreinte, incidents, automatisation, volet infrastructure d’ISO 27001 puis SecNumCloud. Construire et manager l’équipe infrastructure et DevOps, et piloter le TCO et le revenu par GPU. Vos 6 premiers mois 1er mois : le cluster HGX B300 est en production, recetté et conforme à la référence architecture NVIDIA. 3 mois : astreinte et process d’incident en place, plan de capacité à 12 mois validé, contrats fournisseurs clés sécurisés. 6 mois : nouveau cluster ou site déployé dans les délais et le budget, SLA tenu et mesuré, recrutements clés réalisés, ISO 27001 prête pour l’audit côté infrastructure. Votre expérience 10 ans ou plus en infrastructure, dont 3 ans au moins à la tête d’une équipe infrastructure GPU. Au moins un cluster de plusieurs centaines de GPU NVIDIA (HGX) livré en personne Vos expertises Réseaux haute performance : InfiniBand ou RoCE v2 (rail-optimized, fat-tree, gestion de fabric). Data center : colocation, contraintes électriques et thermiques, refroidissement liquide ou plus de 120 kW par baie. Négociation de contrats matériel et colocation. Exploitation en production : SLA, astreinte, gestion d’incidents. Anglais professionnel courant. Un vrai plus : Expérience chez un cloud provider, un neocloud GPU ou un acteur HPC ; Kubernetes et orchestration GPU (GPU Operator, MIG, Slurm) ; Infrastructure as code ; Stockage haute performance ; Stack d’inférence (vLLM, SGLang) ; Pourquoi nous rejoindre Des choix à prendre, pas à subir : vous décidez de l’architecture d’un matériel de toute dernière génération. Un vrai rôle de direction : rattaché au CEO, avec un impact direct sur la trajectoire et les financements de l’entreprise. Une fonction à bâtir : process, équipe, sites. Un cloud souverain français : une alternative européenne aux hyperscalers, avec une équipe resserrée et des décisions rapides. Package et avantages 100 à 120 k€ brut annuel fixe BSPCE Télétravail flexible, deux jours de présence à Lyon toutes les deux semaines (défrayés). Des déplacements réguliers en data center à Paris et chez les fournisseurs sont à prévoir. Mutuelle à 100 %, tickets restaurant, RTT (Convention Syntec) Arkane Cloud s’engage pour la diversité : nous étudions toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d’âge, d’origine ou de handicap . Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&amp;L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br>&nbsp;fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br>&nbsp;network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br>&nbsp;unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br>&nbsp;taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br>&nbsp;on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br>&nbsp;experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.&nbsp;</li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI&nbsp;</em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés. Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus. Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais  (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.

Mise au point et validation

  • Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
  • Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
  • Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.

Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

  • Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
  • Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).

Vie du laboratoire

  • Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
  • Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.

Requirements

Compétences techniques

  • Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
  • Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
  • Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

  • Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
  • Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
  • Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
  • Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
  • Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
  • Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
  • Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

title: Stage - Community Manager (H/F)
description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Community Manager (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Communication à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Rattaché(e) à la Social Media Manager, vous l’accompagnerez dans la gestion quotidienne de nos réseaux sociaux. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la planification et de la gestion du contenu sur nos plateformes de médias sociaux pour renforcer notre image de marque et engager notre communauté en ligne. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Préparation, planification des contenus et gestion des prises de parole quotidiennes (timeline & stories) ; Copywriting des captions sur Instagram ; Proposition et déploiement des actions d’animation de la communauté ; Veille des tendances digitales et sociales ainsi que des contenus UGC; Analyse des performances. Requirements Profil Vous êtes étudiant(e), en école de communication, en école de commerce, ou équivalent universitaire et vous recherchez un stage. Idéalement, vous justifiez d’une première expérience dans un domaine proche ; Vous avez le goût des belles images et des mots qui inspirent ;) ; Vous avez un vrai intérêt pour les réseaux sociaux et vous les utilisez quotidiennement ; Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre esprit de synthèse, rigueur et attention aux détails ; Vous êtes curieux/se, proactif/ve et vous avez l’esprit d’équipe. Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Query Execution
description: <p>The MongoDB Query Execution Team is hiring software engineers who want to join us in developing a high performing, reliable and modular distributed query system. Our engineers work on implementing and maintaining execution algorithms, building new query language features, tuning database performance, and more to power our customers' critical workloads.</p> <p>This role can be based remotely in France.</p> <h3>Position Expectations</h3> <ul> <li>Understand and improve current functionality of the MongoDB query engine</li> <li>Contribute high quality C++ code and give and solicit feedback in code reviews</li> <li>Identify, design, implement, test, and support new features related to query performance and robustness, query language enhancements, diagnostics for query performance problems, and integration with other products and tools</li> <li>Work constructively with peers to deliver excellent technical solutions</li> </ul> <h3>Candidate Profile</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in systems programming</li> <ul> <li>Experience in databases and/or data management systems is a huge plus, but not a requirement</li> </ul> <li>Hands-on experience building industrial-strength software</li> <li>Solid computer science fundamentals, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture</li> <li>Experience with large code bases, preferably in C++, C, Rust or a similar compiled language</li> <li>B.Sc in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent practical experience</li> <li>Interest in the theory and practice of database query engines. Hands-on experience or M.Sc./Ph.D in the domain is a plus</li> </ul> <h3>Success Measures</h3> <ul> <li>In three months you’ll have contributed to the development of a project slated for the next major version, as well as fixed a few bugs in a minor version of our latest stable release series</li> <li>In six months, you’ll have taken on code review responsibilities and are independently delivering complex functionality and squashing bugs independently</li> <li>In twelve months, you’re leading the development of a new major feature and are helping to mentor new engineers on the team</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Who You Are • Critical Thinking & Healthy Skepticism: You possess a strong spirit of questioning everything.
